SkyTruth Analysis

Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS A SODIUM HYDROXIDE STORAGE TANK DEVELOPED A FAILURE, RESULTING IN THE DISCHARGE OF AN ESTIMATED 500-600 GALLONS OF THE PRODUCT INTO A CONTAINMENT AREA. THE CONTAINMENT HAD A DRAIN VALVE THAT WAS LEFT OPEN, WHICH RESULTED IN THE MATERIAL DISCHARGING THROUGH IT ONTO THE OUTSIDE GROUND. THE CONTAINMENT WALL ALSO DEVELOPED 2 FAILURE POINTS, WHICH FURTHER ALLOWED THE PRODUCT TO IMPACT THE GROUND. THE ENTIRE SPILL LEFT CONTAINMENT BETWEEN THESE TWO ESCAPE ROUTES AND IMPACTED THE SOIL. NO IMPACT TO WATER SOURCES WAS REPORTED.
